mods.name: OMWH
mods.description: On My Way Home adds server-side /home and /spawn commands that use Minecraft's saved-home and world-spawn destinations and bring mounted groups with you.

releases.notes:
OMWH 1.2.1 supports Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Fabric API 0.161.0, and Java 25.

- `/home` now recognizes Minecraft 26.3 straw beds and applies the same saved-home terrain preparation and safety rules used for other beds.

mods.name: OMWH
mods.description: On My Way Home adds server-side /home and /spawn commands that use Minecraft's saved-home and world-spawn destinations and bring mounted groups with you.

releases.notes:
OMWH 1.2.0 expands where `/home` and `/spawn` can go and makes destination checks safer on active servers.

- `/home` can now use a valid bed or charged respawn anchor in another dimension when cross-dimension homes are enabled.
- Server owners can enable `/home force` and `/spawn force`. These skip destination safety and vehicle-size checks, but still respect cooldowns, missing destinations, dimension rules, and teleport failures.
- `/spawn` now has separate Overworld, Nether, End, and modded-dimension settings. Nether uses Minecraft's 1:8 coordinate scaling, while End uses Minecraft's normal End arrival.
- Normal teleports prepare terrain and continue safety searches across server ticks instead of refusing unloaded destinations immediately.
- Mounted vehicles and passenger groups stay together more reliably, and `/home` now rejects fluids and hazardous blocks before moving anyone.
- Command messages are fully configurable. Self-damage cooldown handling and invalid config values are also corrected.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Fabric API, and Java 21.

mods.name: OMWH (Java)
mods.description: Adds /home and /spawn teleport commands that stay within the player's current dimension, with configurable cooldowns, messages, aliases, and mount/passenger support.

releases.notes:
This update fixes mounted teleport placement and makes `/spawn` destination checks stricter.

- Fixed `/home` moving mounted players and vehicles upward, sometimes onto roofs, when there was not enough room at the home.
- Fixed mounted `/home` and `/spawn` teleports sometimes leaving clients out of sync with the vehicle and passengers.
- `/spawn` now chooses nearby safe ground with solid support and enough clear space for the player or vehicle.

mods.name: OMWH (Java)
mods.description: Adds /home and /spawn commands with configurable cooldowns, aliases, and messages. Works singleplayer or server-side only.

releases.notes:
## OMWH 1.1.3 test build

This pre-release fixes mounted `/home` and `/spawn` teleports for Minecraft 26.2.

- Vehicles and passengers stay attached through the teleport.
- `/home` uses Minecraft's normal bed and respawn-anchor placement without consuming an anchor charge.
- Mounted teleports check the vehicle's actual size before moving anything.
- If decorations block the normal space beside a bed, a mounted player may use one clear position directly above it. Covered beds still deny the teleport.

This is a pre-release test build. Bugs, unusual vehicle behavior, and placement edge cases should be reported before it becomes the stable release.
